dct_title_s: Chicasaw County, Iowa, 1937, aerial photomosaic index
dct_description_sm: Title supplied by cataloger based on information from sheet labels. Images are photoreductions of mosaics created from original aerial photographs. Designating symbol SQ; form of individual image numbering: SQ-24-[number], SQ-26-[number], SQ-27-[number], SQ-3-[number], SQ-4-[number], or SQ-5-[number]."Date of completion 10-29-37" Flown by Gatschet Aerial Surveys, Des Moines, Iowa."Approximate scale, 1:20,000" [refers to individual images from which mosaic was made]. Library's copy 2 consists of photographic negatives (4 x 5 in.) corresponding to each of the images in its copy 1.
